_comment: 2021 SIIM-FISABIO-RSNA COVID-19 Detection Challenge (Kaggle slug: siim-covid19-detection). 2-D chest X-ray (DICOM). Study-level 4-class appearance (Negative / Typical / Indeterminate / Atypical); image-level bounding boxes for airspace opacities. One row per image (6334 rows across 6054 studies). Labels merged from train_study_level.csv; bboxes parsed from train_image_level.csv and normalized to [0, 1] using DICOM Rows/Columns.

primary_csv._comment: Study-level appearance classes. 'id' column has a '_study' suffix — stripped to match the StudyInstanceUID folder name.

patient_id._comment: No patient column; use StudyInstanceUID so patient-level splits keep all images of a study together.

study_id._comment: Directly the StudyInstanceUID (folder name, matches DICOM header).

image_path._comment: Resolved via one-time directory walk of train/ that maps SOPInstanceUID -> <study>/<series>/<sop>.dcm. Series ID is not in the CSVs, only on disk.

labels._comment: 4 one-hot columns. Each study has exactly one positive class. LABEL_COLS listed alphabetically (snake_case).

uncertain_handling._comment: No uncertain/NaN labels in this dataset.

view_position._comment: Not provided in CSVs. Could be derived from DICOM ViewPosition tag in a follow-up.

bboxes._comment: Multi-bbox per image from train_image_level.csv. 'boxes' column is a Python-literal string of a list of {x, y, width, height} dicts in ORIGINAL DICOM pixel space. NaN = no opacity. Normalized to [y_min/H, y_max/H, x_min/W, x_max/W] by reading DICOM Rows/Columns per image.

extra_init_params._comment: image_csv_path: path to train_image_level.csv (bboxes + image-to-study mapping). Required because the primary CSV is study-level and doesn't list image files.

custom_preprocessing: Bboxes need DICOM Rows/Columns normalization (headers read in parallel for ~4k rows with opacities). Labels are already in [0,1] one-hot form — no further label transformation needed.
